standard_prerequisites: the natural-deduction derivability relation: derivability from a set of open assumptions
core_obligations: Prove that if Gamma is contained in Delta and Gamma proves A, then Delta proves A
proof_roadmap: A derivation of A from Gamma is, by the definition of derivability from a set, a derivation whose open assumptions all lie in Gamma
Since Gamma is contained in Delta, the same derivation has all its open assumptions in Delta, hence is a derivation of A from Delta
difficulty_reason: Immediate from the definition of derivability from a set of assumptions; the task is reading the definition correctly.
